# ANALYSIS: Baseline engine walk-forward OOS and real-fills simulation on 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q2

**Filed:** 2026-08-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** analysis
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are assessing the baseline engine's performance on the walk-forward out-of-sample period 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q2 and real-fills simulation on the top 3 J days plus a non-J sample to determine the edge_capture and Sharpe ratio. This will serve as a baseline for evaluating strategy candidates.

## Mechanism

We ran a walk-forward out-of-sample test from 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q2 (inclusive) using the baseline engine (as of the latest ratified version) and additionally ran a real-fills simulation on the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) and a non-J sample of 10 randomly selected days from the same period to evaluate slippage and fill quality.
